commands:
set -eu
base=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
cd "$wt"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 91334a76de1e8d239c68dff9c29002847a6c5097
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = fix/macbook-trackpad-zoom
for pair in "frontend/node_modules" "backend/.venv"; do
  if test -L "$wt/$pair"; then
    test "$(readlink "$wt/$pair")" = "$base/$pair"
    unlink "$wt/$pair"
    mkdir -p "$wt/$pair"
    rsync -a "$base/$pair/" "$wt/$pair/"
  fi
done
test ! -L frontend/node_modules
test ! -L backend/.venv
test -x frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite
test -x backend/.venv/bin/python
backend/.venv/bin/python -c 'import sys, fastapi, alembic, uvicorn; print("BACKEND_PYTHON_READY",sys.prefix)'
printf 'FORMATTING_PROTOTYPE\n'
frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier --write frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts frontend/src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts frontend/e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
printf 'TRACKPAD_TESTS_AND_BUILD\n'
cd frontend
npm run test -- src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts
npm run build
./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
cd "$wt"
printf 'GIT_STATUS_BEFORE_COMMIT\n'
git status --short
git add -- frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts frontend/src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts frontend/e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m "style(map): format experimental smooth trackpad zoom"
  git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/fix/macbook-trackpad-zoom
fi
printf 'GIT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'GIT_CLEAN_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'BASE_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git -C "$base" branch --show-current)"
echo PHOTOMAP_MAC_ZOOM_LOCAL_READY_CLEAN_COMPLETE
